node.statement: Conditionally assume ||A dot B||<=K_m||A||||B|| for compatible amplified rectangular pairs. Node 1.1.1 gives q_P(V)<=K_q||V|| for output columns V and ||U||<=K_q q_T(U) for input columns U. Hence q_P(A dot U)<=K_q||A dot U||<=K_q*K_m||A||||U||<=K_q^2*K_m||A||q_T(U). This proves only the stated conditional implication and makes explicit that K_m itself is unavailable from the permitted inputs.
